(rule!
  (let ()
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b))
          (< (second a) (second b))
          (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (sign n)
      (cond [(> n 0) 1] [(< n 0) -1] [else 0]))
    (define (span-cells a b)
      (let* ((r1 (first a)) (c1 (second a))
             (r2 (first b)) (c2 (second b))
             (dr (sign (- r2 r1)))
             (dc (sign (- c2 c1)))
             (n (max (abs (- r2 r1)) (abs (- c2 c1)))))
        (for/list ([i (in-range 0 (+ n 1))])
          (list (+ r1 (* i dr)) (+ c1 (* i dc))))))
    (define (nonzero-points grid)
      (sort
        (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (second cell)))
             (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0)))
                     (grid-cells grid)))
        cell<))
    (let* ((pts (nonzero-points g))
           (seg (span-cells (first pts) (second pts)))
           (mid (list-ref seg (quotient (length seg) 2)))
           (anchor (first (find-color g 9)))
           (key-row (first anchor))
           (key-color (at g key-row (second mid)))
           (payloads
             (filter (lambda (obj)
                       (and (= (obj-color obj) key-color)
                            (> (obj-size obj) 1)))
                     (objects g 0)))
           (target (first payloads)))
      (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
                   (obj-cells target)
                   8))))
